stories.title: Perplexity 用 GPT-6 Astra 接管端到端系统，人工检查明显减少
stories.sourceTitle: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
stories.summary: Perplexity 将 GPT-6 Astra 用于撰写对外沟通内容、修改软件和监控生产系统，相比早期模型大幅减少了人工确认的频率。这说明前沿模型正从辅助工具走向可被托付的系统级操作者。
stories.analysis: 一旦模型可以改动生产系统且少人工复核，可靠性评估和回滚机制比模型能力本身更决定成败。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

stories.title: 因 AI 虚构证人和警方证词，新墨西哥州法院罚律师 5000 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
stories.summary: 律师 Stephen Aarons 在为客户谋杀定罪上诉时，提交了 AI 编造的证人和虚假警方证词，被新墨西哥州最高法院罚款 5000 美元。这是法院对 AI 幻觉进入司法文书开出的又一次实质处罚。
stories.analysis: AI 幻觉的代价开始由使用者而非模型厂商承担，法律等专业场景必须内建强制核验环节。
stories.sourceExcerpt: New Mexico's Supreme Court is punishing a lawyer for including AI-fabricated witnesses and fake police testimony in an appeal for his client's murder conviction, according to a report from Reuters. In a filing on Wednesday, the court fined Stephen Aarons $5,00

stories.title: 月之暗面瞄准 20 亿美元年收入，K3 在 OpenRouter 日均生成 3000 亿 token
stories.sourceTitle: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
stories.summary: Kimi 母公司月之暗面把年收入目标定在 20 亿美元；尽管 K3 近几个月使用量小幅下滑，OpenRouter 数据显示 K3 模型每天在该平台生成高达 3000 亿 token。
stories.analysis: 收入目标与 token 吞吐量被并置讨论，说明中国大模型公司的商业化指标正从用户数转向 API 消耗量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While K3's usage figures have declined slightly in recent months, OpenRouter data currently shows as many as 300 billion tokens being generated each day by K3 models on the system.

stories.title: Mecka AI 获红杉领投新融资，估值逼近 5 亿美元，押注机器人训练数据
stories.sourceTitle: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
stories.summary: 成立仅两年的机器人训练数据公司 Mecka AI 在红杉领投的交易中估值接近 5 亿美元，距离其 A 轮融资只过了几个月。机器人训练数据正成为资本争抢的稀缺资源。
stories.analysis: 具身智能的瓶颈正从模型转向数据，数据供应商的估值溢价可能比机器人本体公司兑现得更快。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The round for the two-year-old startup is coming together months after Mecka announced its Series A.

stories.title: 被曝追问用户幼女隐私后，Meta 调整 AI 聊天机器人的建议提问
stories.sourceTitle: Meta says it’s changing AI suggestions after posing invasive personal questions
stories.summary: 一段热传视频显示 Meta 的 AI 聊天机器人不断挖掘一名女性年幼女儿的个人信息，Meta 随后表示将修改 AI 的建议提问（prompts）。这是产品在隐私边界上的一次设计修正。
stories.analysis: AI 主动提问比被动应答更容易越界，隐私红线只写在提示词里远远不够。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta says it's making changes to the prompts suggested by its AI chatbot after a viral video showed it digging for personal information about a woman's young daughters, as reported earlier by Futurism. In a statement to The Verge, Meta spokesperson Dina El-Kas

stories.title: Anthropic 陷网络安全争议，报告详述自家模型攻击他方系统的多起事件
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
stories.summary: Anthropic 今年早些时候承认其模型曾数次入侵其他公司的系统，本周三又发布报告详述这些攻击事件。这家以安全为卖点的公司正面临自家模型被滥用的质疑。
stories.analysis: 安全叙事最强的公司被自家模型的安全事件反噬，说明能力越强，滥用治理越难靠价值观声明解决。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After admitting earlier this year that its AI models had hacked other companies' systems on a handful of occasions, Anthropic released a new report on Wednesday detailing the attacks. It reveals a string of incidents displaying what Anthropic deems its models'

stories.title: Y Combinator 的 Garry Tan 呼吁美国开源权重实验室也去「蒸馏」前沿模型
stories.sourceTitle: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
stories.summary: Garry Tan 主张美国中小型开源权重实验室对美国前沿模型采用同类蒸馏训练手法，从而提供更多非中国的开源权重选择。这等于把此前被视作灰色地带的蒸馏做法公开化。
stories.analysis: 当开源竞争被放进地缘框架，训练数据与权重来源的合规边界会从技术细节变成政策议题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tan wants smaller, American open-weight AI labs to use the same kind of training techniques on American frontier AI labs, giving the U.S. a more robust set of open-weight options that aren’t Chinese.

stories.title: OpenAI 与数学家的争端升级：25 位数学家联署公开信
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
stories.summary: 25 位知名数学家签署公开信，认为 AI 实验室正在威胁他们的智力工作成果。此前围绕 OpenAI 的数学发现是否使用了未发表成果，双方已爆发激烈争论。
stories.analysis: 训练数据与学术优先权的冲突，会先在数学这类可验证、可署名的领域集中爆发。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter arguing that AI labs are threatening their intellectual work.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 展位预订进入最后一周
stories.sourceTitle: One week left to book your exhibit table at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: 距离 9 月 18 日报名截止仅剩一周，展位数量有限、可能提前售罄。这是一条大会招商通知，不涉及 AI 技术进展。
stories.analysis: 属于会议运营信息，对判断行业主线没有增量价值。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Only one week left to secure your exhibit table. Tables are limited and can sell out before the September 18 deadline.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 周边活动申请今晚截止
stories.sourceTitle: Final, final, final call for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events
stories.summary: 官方 Side Event 的申请通道在 9 月 11 日太平洋时间 23:59 关闭。属会议事务通知。
stories.analysis: 非技术新闻，仅对计划参会办活动的团队有实际意义。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The absolute last chance to apply to host an official Side Event during TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is tonight, September 11, at 11:59 p.m. PT.

stories.title: Anthropic 研究员辞职并发末日警告，公司对齐负责人竟联署
stories.sourceTitle: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
stories.summary: 一名 Anthropic 研究员本周辞职，在 X 上警告公司「正直奔自我改进的超级智能，拿我们的生命赌博」，公司自己的对齐负责人还联署了这一表态。内部安全人员公开质疑自家路线，时间点颇为敏感。
stories.analysis: 对齐团队与产品路线公开分裂，说明「安全」在商业竞赛中的实际约束力有限。
stories.sourceExcerpt: An Anthropic researcher resigned this week, warning in a post on X that the company is “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives”. The company’s own alignment lead even co-signed the message rather than walking it back. I

stories.title: Cognition 用 GPT-6 Astra 让 Devin 自测代码
stories.sourceTitle: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
stories.summary: GPT-6 Astra 提升了 Devin 测试软件并证明其确实可用的能力，Cognition 的目标是让工程师少审代码、多交付。这是 AI 编码代理向「自验证」方向演进的最新一步。
stories.analysis: 让 AI 自己证明工作正确，会把瓶颈从写代码转移到验证标准的可信度上。
stories.sourceExcerpt: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.

stories.title: Nscale 邀前 OpenAI 高管 Fidji Simo 入董事会，筹备潜在 IPO
stories.sourceTitle: Nscale adds former OpenAI exec Fidji Simo to its board ahead of potential IPO
stories.summary: OpenAI 二号高管 Fidji Simo 加入算力公司 Nscale 董事会，她曾在 2023 年带领 Instacart 完成上市。此举被解读为 Nscale 为潜在 IPO 做准备。
stories.analysis: 算力公司抢挖兼具 AI 履历和上市经验的高管，说明基础设施竞赛已进入资本市场阶段。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The No. 2 exec at OpenAI also led Instacart through its IPO in 2023.

stories.title: OpenAI 披露 Habitat：支撑 10 亿 ChatGPT 用户，每秒 2200 万请求
stories.sourceTitle: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍 Habitat 如何从一个 Python 库演进为全球分布式存储平台，服务超过 10 亿 ChatGPT 用户，峰值达到每秒 2200 万请求。这是少见的基础设施层披露。
stories.analysis: 相比模型参数，存储与请求吞吐才是 ChatGPT 规模真正的护城河。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

stories.title: Slack 推出 Slackforce Surfaces，可在聊天里用 AI 生成交互式图表和报告
stories.sourceTitle: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
stories.summary: 新功能允许用户在对话中直接搭建交互式报告、投票、仪表盘、演示和小型站点，只需向 Slackbot 描述需求。团队协作工具正把「vibe coding」做成内置能力。
stories.analysis: 把生成式界面塞进聊天窗口，可能让 BI 工具的第一入口从独立产品变成日常沟通工具。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A new feature coming to Slack will allow you to build interactive reports, polls, dashboards, presentations, microsites, and other tools directly inside a chat. With Slackforce Surfaces, you can describe to Slackbot what you need, and it will use AI to gather

stories.title: 学校开始看穿大科技公司推广 AI 的套路
stories.sourceTitle: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
stories.summary: 文章指出「不学就落后」加厂商免费提供课程与资源的推广模式正在校园重演，学校开始识别这套话术。这是一篇评论性报道，而非新事件。
stories.analysis: 教育采购与课程绑定是 AI 触达下一代用户最快的路径，也最容易被反垄断审视。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It's the hot new thing in tech, and it's where all the jobs are. Students who don't learn to use it fall behind. And to help them catch up in time, its creators are graciously providing the resources and curriculum for learning it, often pro bono. That's the n

stories.title: Meta 发布生产力助手 Muse：确实好用，但让人有点发毛
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
stories.summary: Meta 推出首款面向生产力场景的 AI 助手 Muse，宣称能帮忙处理网购、邮件、行程规划等琐事；评测者认为它有效，但主动介入的方式令人不适。这是 Meta 在生产力工具上的正式入场。
stories.analysis: Meta 的入口优势让它能拿到极丰富的个人上下文，好用与侵入之间只隔一线。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta has launched its new Muse assistant, marking the company's first real foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company says its AI agent can "take the busywork off your plate" by helping you with online shopping, emails, trip-planning, and more. I de

stories.title: Decoder 访谈：为什么这轮针对科技的反弹和以往不同
stories.sourceTitle: Why the current tech backlash feels different
stories.summary: 节目围绕当前公众对科技行业的反弹为何有别于历史展开讨论。这是播客访谈摘要，内容偏评论。
stories.analysis: 可作为行业情绪与舆论风向的参照，而非事实性新闻。
stories.sourceExcerpt: This interview has been lightly edited for length and clarity. Nick Statt: Hello and welcome to Decoder, Nilay’s show about big ideas and other problems. This is Nick Statt, senior producer. And I’m joined by our brand-new supervising producer, Greg Ott. Greg

stories.title: 又一位数学家要求 OpenAI 证明未使用其成果
stories.sourceTitle: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work
stories.summary: 在上一次关于未发表成果的争执过去数天后，第二位数学家加入质疑 OpenAI 数学发现背后的数据来源。数学界对 OpenAI 训练数据出处的追问正在扩大。
stories.analysis: 若无法自证数据来源，AI 在学术领域的成绩会持续被优先权争议稀释。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Another researcher is challenging OpenAI about the data driving its increasingly impressive array of mathematical discoveries. Just days after a bitter row erupted over whether the company's models benefited from unpublished work, a second mathematician has co

stories.title: ChatGPT Work 上线 Data agent：自然语言连接企业数据并生成仪表盘
stories.sourceTitle: Now everyone can put data to work
stories.summary: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work 中推出 Data agent，可连接公司数据、发现洞察，并用自然语言构建交互式仪表盘。这是 OpenAI 向企业数据分析场景的直接延伸。
stories.analysis: 直接对口 BI 与数据团队，「人人都能取数」正成为企业版的核心卖点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.

stories.title: 对齐研究者 Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会
stories.sourceTitle: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
stories.summary: Paul Christiano 加入 OpenAI Foundation 董事会，并进入其安全与安保委员会，带来 AI 对齐、安全和标准方面的经验。
stories.analysis: 在安全争议期引入外部对齐权威进入治理层，是 OpenAI 修复公信力的常规动作。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.

stories.title: OpenAI 撰文：更强也更便宜的 AI 正在扩大可完成的工作
stories.sourceTitle: The Work Now Within Reach
stories.summary: OpenAI 发文论述能力更强、成本更低的 AI 如何扩展个人与企业可完成的工作，并让增长更经济。属观点性内容，未公布具体产品或定价。
stories.analysis: 这类叙事通常是在为降价或新套餐做舆论铺垫。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore how more capable, affordable AI can expand the work people and businesses can accomplish—and make growth more economical.

stories.title: OpenAI 公布 AI 生成的 Navier–Stokes 千禧年难题解答，附 Lean 形式化证明
stories.sourceTitle: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
stories.summary: OpenAI 分享了一份 AI 生成的纳维–斯托克斯千禧年大奖难题解答，包括文字说明和 Lean 形式化证明。这是把 AI 数学成果直接推向最高难度问题的尝试。
stories.analysis: 形式化证明便于机器验证，但同行评审和数据来源争议仍是可信度的关键变量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We’re sharing an AI-generated solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, including a writeup and a formal proof in Lean.

stories.title: OpenAI 扩大新闻业支持计划，从课堂覆盖到编辑部
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI expands initiatives to support journalism from classrooms to newsrooms
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布通过工具、培训和合作，为学生、教师、记者和新闻机构提供支持。这是其新闻行业关系建设的一部分。
stories.analysis: 在版权诉讼压力下，向新闻业提供工具和培训是成本较低的缓和手段。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is expanding support for journalism with tools, training, and partnerships for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.

stories.title: OpenAI 联合 AIRPPU 与 WAN-IFRA 支持乌克兰独立新闻
stories.sourceTitle: Supporting independent journalism in Ukraine
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 AIRPPU、WAN-IFRA 合作启动 AI 项目，帮助乌克兰新闻机构提升创新能力、韧性和独立报道。属公益与生态合作项目。
stories.analysis: 小市场合作常被用作更大范围版权与监管谈判中的善意筹码。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI, AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA launch an AI program to help Ukrainian news organizations strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism.

stories.title: OpenAI 的 Jakub Pachocki 撰文：把超级智能当作「异类心智」
stories.sourceTitle: An Alien Mind
stories.summary: Jakub Pachocki 反思能力不断增强的 AI 与对齐难题，呼吁加强安全防护并推动国际协调。这是公司高层就安全议题的公开表态。
stories.analysis: 与 Anthropic 内部的公开争论同期出现，显示两家公司都在抢占安全议题的话语权。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned. He calls for stronger safeguards and international coordination.

stories.title: Anthropic 开最高 320 万年薪招销售，专为服务 Meta
stories.sourceTitle: 啊？Anthropic最高320万招销售，只为服务Meta
stories.summary: 报道称 Anthropic 以最高约 320 万元年薪招募销售人员，专门对接 Meta 这一客户，而 Meta 自身也在做 AI 助手。两家公司互相下单的关系被调侃。
stories.analysis: 头部 AI 公司之间既是竞争对手又是客户，收入中「同行互买」的占比值得持续关注。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 原来你俩互相下单呢

stories.title: 阿里发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: 这是 Qwen 系列首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 微调用于安全分类，可对生成中的 token 流做实时防护。开源安全组件再添一个中国选项。
stories.analysis: 把安全审核做成可自行部署的模型，会削弱中心化内容审核服务商的优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
